tools.name: calculate_brew_ratio
tools.description: Calculate this roastery's recommended pour-over recipe: cups of coffee → grams of ground coffee and grams of water. Uses the shop's own brewing guide (1 cup = 200 g water; strong 1:15, balanced 1:16, bright 1:17). Pure, instant calculation.

cups.description: How many cups to brew (1–12). One cup = 2 dl.

strength.description: strong = 1:15, balanced = 1:16, bright = 1:17. Defaults to balanced.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read the current shopping cart: line items with ids (usable with the cart page's update and remove tools — navigate to '/en/cart' to use them), quantities, per-line and total prices with currency, and stock ceilings.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to an internal page on this store, e.g. '/en/produkter', '/en/produkter?q=oak', or '/en/product/<slug>'. Accepts same-origin paths beginning with '/'.

tools.name: newsletter_signup
tools.description: Subscribe an email address to this store's newsletter. Asks the user to confirm before submitting.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search this store's product catalogue by free text and return matching products (id, title, minor-unit price, formatted price, currency, url, stock). Returns results directly without changing the page.

limit.description: Max results to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: site_search
tools.description: Search this store's product catalogue and open the results page.
